verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same: both are the square layout scaled down to 300x250 with no real rearrangement. In both, the 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' attribution and the 'SOLSTICE' can label are too small to read, and the can sits jammed against the bottom edge. Under the quote there is a band of dead space while the left half of the canvas is mostly empty. The colours, fonts and quote all survive intact.
